messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-05-22, the Dune team observed that auth-gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-2]
- Authentication gateway token expiry was shortened to 15 minutes because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- At the Cinder standup on 2026-01-30, it was decided that authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-18]
- The ledger service relies on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- Every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-07-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-07-29]
- The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder on 2025-09-16; Cinder owns it as of that date. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the authentication gateway. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-09-16; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-08-07, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- The Cinder team observed on 2025-09-03 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03-2]
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- At the Boreal standup on 2025-11-03, it was decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03]
- Clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, decided at the Atlas standup on 2025-09-02. [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the handover doc for Diego for the authentication gateway handover to Cinder. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team observed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- Follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review: the webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
